source: Technology Promotion Project to Increase Productivity Around Tonle Sap (TSTD — TA 7305-CAM), watermelon (ដំណាំឪឡឹក) technical training booklet, prepared by the project's agricultural techniques and extension officer in cooperation with East West Seed International, November 2016. Contact: livleanghy@gmail.com
text:
Thrips (ត្រីប) are a small insect pest of watermelon that especially damage the growing tip/shoot area of the plant, feeding on young leaves and flower buds. Thrips are also noted as an important vector that helps spread plant viruses in the crop.

Recommended prevention and control measures: spray water over the crop canopy regularly, twice a day if possible, which can help dislodge/discourage thrips; increase use of urea fertilizer (46-0-0) to support plant vigor; and apply agricultural pesticides such as Abamectin, Dinotefuran, Imidacloprid, or Thiamethoxam to control thrips populations.
